info.name: Housing Platform API
info.description:
Production-shaped REST API for the Housing & Roommate Management Platform (B7A6 backend assignment).

Covers every endpoint shipped in Phases 5–21: Auth, Users, Profiles, Preferences, KYC, Properties, Buildings, Rooms, Search, Applications, Viewings, Leases, Invoices, Payments, Bills, Meters, Readings, Maintenance Tickets, Notifications, Documents, Match, Admin Moderation, Audit Logs, Feature Flags.

Role-aware auth: every non-public request picks up the Bearer token from `{{accessToken}}` via the collection-level pre-request script. Run `/auth/login` first to populate it.

Idempotency: every mutating POST/PUT/PATCH that runs through `withIdempotency` middleware gets an `Idempotency-Key: {{idempotencyKey}}` header (auto-rotated per request) — safe to retry.

exec: // Rotate Idempotency-Key on every request so retries of a single
// Postman click land on the same key (server caches 24h) but
// If the request body is JSON and the endpoint expects an
// Auto-rotate the key AFTER appending so the next request gets a fresh one.
// Standard envelope shape: { success, message, data, meta? }.
// Most endpoints also stash `id` in `data.id`; capture that into
// the environment so the next request can reference it.
